title: Skip Steam's link filter warning
question: How do I skip the Steam 'you are leaving Steam' link filter page?
answer: Steam has no setting to turn off its link filter, but a userscript can point the links straight at their destination. Steam sends outside links through steamcommunity.com/linkfilter, which can stop you on a "You are about to leave Steam" warning. The usermods script on this page rewrites those links on the Steam store and community to the real address, and if you open a link filter URL directly it goes straight to the destination.
prompt: Make links on Steam go straight to the website instead of through Steam's link filter warning page.
details:
Steam wraps outside links as `https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=<address>` (older ones use `?url=`). The script reads the address out of the link and puts it back as the link target, on page load and whenever new content appears. Only `http` and `https` addresses are followed.

The warning exists to catch scam and phishing links, which are common in Steam chat and comments. With the script, those links open without that pause.

The check loads a store game page and confirms the developer's website and social links point straight at their sites. It does not load community pages or a link filter URL.

alternatives.title: Copy the address
alternatives.body: The destination is in the link itself, after `?u=`. Right-click, copy the link, and paste the part after `?u=` into the address bar (it is URL-encoded, so `%3A%2F%2F` stands for `://`).

evidence.note: Greasy Fork total installs: "Direct links out" (36,460), a multi-site script
Greasy Fork total installs: "Steam Linkfilter Redirector" (1,261)

check.expect: (() => { const links = [...document.querySelectorAll('.details_block a')]; return document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/linkfilter/"]').length === 0 && links.some((a) => a.href === 'https://www.thewitcher.com/witcher3') && links.some((a) => a.href.startsWith('https://discord.gg/')); })()
check.intact: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#game_area_purchase'); const name = document.querySelector('#appHubAppName'); return !!p && p.checkVisibility() && !!name && /Witcher/.test(name.textContent); })()
